# Associate Product Manager
Lumenfield · Full-time

What you'll do

- Own a feature area from discovery to launch.
- Work with engineering, design and data science.
- Define success metrics and track them.

Requirements

- 0-2 years of product experience; new grads welcome.
- Experience running user research and synthesizing findings.
- Write clear product requirements.
- Comfort with data: SQL or product analytics.
- Prioritize with clear trade-offs.

Nice to have

- Familiarity with Figma.
- Technical background.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Lumenfield is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
